stories.headline: Trump Orders US Naval Blockade of Iranian Ports After Islamabad Talks Collapse

key_facts.fact: Trump announced on Truth Social that the US Navy would blockade all ships entering or leaving Iranian ports via the Strait of Hormuz, effective Monday at 10 a.m. ET.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. military's Central Command, also known as CENTCOM, on Sunday said the blockade would begin at 10 a.m. ET on Monday. However, CENTCOM said ships not using Iranian ports would not be impeded.

key_facts.fact: CENTCOM said the blockade would be 'enforced impartially against vessels of all nations entering or departing Iranian ports' but would not impede ships transiting to non-Iranian destinations.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. Central Command said the blockade would be 'enforced impartially against vessels of all nations' entering or departing Iranian ports and coastal areas, including all Iranian ports on the Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman.

key_facts.fact: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said any military vessels approaching the Strait of Hormuz would be considered a violation of the ceasefire and 'dealt with severely.'
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) said any military vessels approaching the strait would be 'dealt with severely.'

key_facts.fact: Iran's military called the blockade 'piracy' and warned that if Iranian port security is threatened, 'no port in the Persian Gulf and the Sea of Oman will remain safe.'
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's military said that such a move would 'amount to piracy,' and that if the security of Iranian ports in the Persian Gulf and the Sea of Oman was threatened, 'no port in the Persian Gulf and the Sea of Oman will remain safe.'

key_facts.fact: Vice President Vance said the core sticking point was Iran's refusal to commit to abandoning nuclear weapons, stating: 'We need to see an affirmative commitment that they will not seek a nuclear weapon.'
key_facts.excerpt: The simple fact is that we need to see an affirmative commitment that they will not seek a nuclear weapon, and they will not seek the tools that would enable them to quickly achieve a nuclear weapon.

key_facts.fact: The status of the two-week ceasefire is now uncertain; Pakistan urged both sides to maintain it and said it would continue facilitating peace efforts.
key_facts.excerpt: The status of the two-week ceasefire is now uncertain. But Vance left open the possibility that an agreement could still be reached.

stories.headline: Oil Surges 7-8% Past $100 on US Blockade Announcement; Global Markets Decline

key_facts.fact: Brent crude jumped 7% to $102.24/barrel and US WTI surged 8% to $104.24/barrel in early Monday trading after Trump's blockade announcement.
key_facts.excerpt: The price of U.S. crude oil rose 8% to $104.24 a barrel and Brent crude oil, the international standard, rose 7% to $102.29.

key_facts.fact: Brent crude has swung from ~$70/barrel before the war in late February to peaks above $119 during the conflict; it closed at $95.20 on Friday before the talks.
key_facts.excerpt: Brent crude has swung dramatically during the Iran war, rising from roughly $70 per barrel before the war in late February to more than $119 at times. On Friday, ahead of the peace talks, Brent for June delivery fell 0.8% to $95.20 per barrel.

key_facts.fact: Analyst Saul Kavonic (MST Marquee) said the blockade will cut up to 2 million barrels/day of Iranian-linked flows, returning the market to pre-ceasefire conditions.
key_facts.excerpt: The market is now largely back to conditions before the ceasefire, except now the US will block the remaining up to 2 million barrels per day of Iranian-linked flows through the Strait of Hormuz as well.

key_facts.fact: European and Asian markets declined: France's CAC 40 fell 1.0%, Germany's DAX lost 1.0%, Japan's Nikkei 225 dropped 0.7%, and US futures pointed lower.
key_facts.excerpt: France's CAC 40 dropped 1.0% to 8,174.44 in early trading, while the German DAX lost 1.0% to 23,568.65. Britain's FTSE 100 slipped 0.4% to 10,561.47.

key_facts.fact: Rystad Energy chief economist said the blockade 'will raise prices' but called it a 'negotiation tactic, which eventually resolves into a full opening of Hormuz.'
key_facts.excerpt: Claudio Galimberti, chief economist of Rystad Energy, said the blockade will raise prices but might move the needle on talks. 'It means the oil markets will be even tighter than before,' he said. 'However, I think this is a negotiation tactic, which eventually resolves into a full opening of Hormuz.'

key_facts.fact: Trump acknowledged oil and gasoline prices may remain high through November's midterm elections, a rare admission of political fallout from the Iran war decision.
key_facts.excerpt: He added that the price of oil and gasoline may remain high through November's midterm elections, a rare acknowledgement of the potential political fallout from his decision to attack Iran six weeks ago.

stories.headline: Orbán Concedes Defeat as Magyar's Tisza Party Wins Supermajority in Hungary

key_facts.fact: Tisza secured 53.53% of the vote with 81.49% counted, projected to win 137 seats — enough for a two-thirds supermajority to amend the constitution. Fidesz-KDNP received 37.84%, projected at 55 seats.
key_facts.excerpt: With 81.49 percent of the votes counted by the National Election Office, Tisza secured 53.53 percent of the vote, projecting to win 137 seats. Orban's ruling coalition of Fidesz and the Christian Democratic People's Party (KDNP) received 37.84 percent and is projected to win 55 seats.

key_facts.fact: Turnout was approximately 77.8% — a record high with 7.52 million out of ~8.1 million eligible voters casting ballots, the highest since the fall of communism.
key_facts.excerpt: About 7.52 million Hungarians cast their ballots, out of around 8.1 million eligible voters, marking a record-high turnout of approximately 77.8 percent.

key_facts.fact: Orbán conceded within three hours of polls closing and called Magyar to congratulate him, ending his 16 years in power.
key_facts.excerpt: Orbán congratulated Magyar in a concession speech less than three hours after polls closed.

key_facts.fact: Magyar, 45, a former Orbán loyalist, told supporters beside the Danube: 'Together we overthrew the Hungarian regime.' He pledged to steer Hungary back toward the EU.
key_facts.excerpt: 'We did it,' Mr Magyar told a crowd of cheering supporters in a square beside the River Danube. 'Together we overthrew the Hungarian regime.'

key_facts.fact: UK PM Starmer called it 'an historic moment, not only for Hungary, but for European democracy.' The Kremlin loses an ally that had blocked EU funding for Ukraine.
key_facts.excerpt: Sir Keir Starmer hailed Mr Orban's defeat in Hungary's election as a 'historic moment, not only for Hungary, but for European democracy'.

key_facts.fact: A supermajority would let Magyar undo Orbán-era constitutional changes that weakened judicial independence and entrenched Fidesz control of political institutions.
key_facts.excerpt: If that happens, he would be able to undo constitutional changes made by Orbán to weaken the independence of the judiciary and entrench the Fidesz party's control of political life.

stories.headline: Trump Threatens China With 50% Tariff if It Supplies Weapons to Iran

key_facts.fact: Trump told Fox News on Sunday that China would face a 50% tariff on all goods entering the US if caught providing military assistance to Iran during the war.
key_facts.excerpt: 'If we catch them doing that, they get a 50 percent tariff, which is a staggering – that's a staggering amount,' Trump told Fox News show 'Sunday Morning Futures with Maria Bartiromo.'

key_facts.fact: The threat follows US intelligence indicating China is preparing to ship air defense weapons (portable missiles targeting low-flying aircraft) to Iran via third countries.
key_facts.excerpt: Tensions have increased after reports suggested that China may be preparing to send weapons to Iran. According to recent intelligence findings cited in media reports, there are concerns that new air defense systems could be delivered within the next few weeks.

key_facts.fact: Legal experts note the threat faces major hurdles: the Supreme Court struck down Trump's use of IEEPA for tariffs last February, and alternative legal tools require months-long investigations.
key_facts.excerpt: 'It's a lot more complicated to do that after IEEPA was struck down,' said Rachel Ziemba, adjunct senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security. 'There's no immediate policy lever and authorisation that is available for the US to do that.'

key_facts.fact: Trump is scheduled to visit Beijing in mid-May for talks with Xi Jinping; the meeting was delayed due to the Iran war.
key_facts.excerpt: The US leader is scheduled to visit Beijing next month for talks with his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping, after delaying an earlier summit because of the war against Iran.

key_facts.fact: China denied the allegations, stating it has not provided weapons to any party in the conflict and called the reports 'untrue.'
key_facts.excerpt: China has strongly denied these claims. Officials stated that the country has not provided weapons to any party in the conflict. They called the reports untrue and urged others to avoid spreading baseless allegations.

stories.headline: France and UK to Discuss Independent Hormuz Navigation Mission, Distancing From US Blockade

key_facts.fact: France's President Macron announced France would organize a meeting with the UK and other willing countries to discuss a 'strictly defensive' multinational mission to restore freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.
key_facts.excerpt: France's president Emmanuel Macron has said that his country will organize a meeting with the U.K. about how to restore freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.

key_facts.fact: Macron described the mission as 'separate from the warring parties to the conflict' and 'intended to be deployed as soon as circumstances permit,' distancing from the US blockade.
key_facts.excerpt: 'This strictly defensive mission, separate from the warring parties to the conflict, is intended to be deployed as soon as circumstances permit,' Macron's post said, distancing itself from the belligerents in the Iran War.

key_facts.fact: UK PM Keir Starmer said Britain would not take part in the US blockade but remained 'committed to reopening the critical waterway.'
key_facts.excerpt: The post follows UK prime minister Keir Starmer saying that his country would not take part in the U.S. blockade of the strait announced by President Donald Trump although he has said that he was committed to reopening the critical waterway.

key_facts.fact: A CBS poll found 59% of Americans feel the Iran war is going 'somewhat or very badly' for the US, with bipartisan majorities saying key objectives — including keeping Hormuz open — remain unmet.
key_facts.excerpt: A new CBS poll suggests that most Americans (59%) feel the war is going somewhat or very badly for the US. Many believe the key US objectives - such as keeping open the Strait of Hormuz, securing greater freedom for the Iranian people and permanently ending Iran's nuclear programme - remain unmet.

stories.headline: Russia-Ukraine Easter Ceasefire Marred by Thousands of Violations on Both Sides

key_facts.fact: Ukraine's General Staff reported 7,696 Russian violations over the 32-hour ceasefire, including 1,355 artillery incidents, 115 assault operations, and 6,226 drone strikes. No air strikes were recorded.
key_facts.excerpt: The latest report by the Ukrainian General Staff said the 7,696 Russian violations noted over the course of the truce included 1,355 artillery shelling incidents, 115 assault operations and 6,226 strikes by attack drones. It said no air strikes had been recorded.

key_facts.fact: Russia's defence ministry said it recorded 1,971 ceasefire violations by Ukraine overnight into Sunday.
key_facts.excerpt: The Russian defence ministry said it recorded 1,971 ceasefire violations overnight into Sunday.

key_facts.fact: Two people were killed in Russia's Belgorod region by Ukrainian shelling; two Ukrainian civilians were wounded by a Russian drone attack in Kharkiv region.
key_facts.excerpt: The Belgorod region's governor, Vyacheslav Gladkov, reported two people killed by Ukrainian shelling and several injured in other strikes through the border region.

key_facts.fact: Kremlin spokesman Peskov called the truce a 'humanitarian gesture' and said Russian troops would resume fighting as soon as it ends at midnight (2100 GMT Sunday).
key_facts.excerpt: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said on Sunday the truce was a 'humanitarian gesture' from Russian President Vladimir Putin, but that Russian troops would resume fighting as soon as it ends.

key_facts.fact: A Ukrainian soldier from the 65th brigade said Russian reconnaissance drones continued circling over Zaporizhzhia, blocking efforts to recover fallen soldiers' bodies.
key_facts.excerpt: A soldier from Ukraine's 65th brigade fighting in Zaporizhzhia said Russian reconnaissance drones were still circling the area despite the ceasefire, blocking efforts to recover the bodies of fallen troops.

stories.headline: FDA Approves J&J's Icotyde, First Targeted Oral Peptide for Plaque Psoriasis

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved Icotyde (icotrokinra), an interleukin-23 receptor antagonist, for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis in adults and adolescents 12+ weighing at least 40 kg.
key_facts.excerpt: Johnson & Johnson announced that the FDA has approved Icotyde (icotrokinra), an interleukin-23 (IL-23) receptor antagonist for the treatment of moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis in adults and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older who weigh at least 40 kg.

key_facts.fact: Icotyde is the first and only targeted oral peptide that precisely blocks the IL-23 receptor, replacing injections with a once-daily pill.
key_facts.excerpt: Icotyde is the first and only targeted oral peptide that precisely blocks the IL-23 receptor.

key_facts.fact: In head-to-head Phase III studies, approximately 70% of patients achieved clear or almost clear skin (IGA 0/1) and 55% achieved PASI 90 response at Week 16.
key_facts.excerpt: In the head-to-head superiority studies, approximately 70% of patients achieved clear or almost clear skin (IGA 0/1) and 55% of patients achieved a Psoriasis Area and Severity Index (PASI) 90 response at Week 16.

key_facts.fact: The approval is based on the ICONIC clinical development program spanning four Phase III studies with 2,500 patients; adverse reactions were within 1.1% of placebo through Week 16.
key_facts.excerpt: Icotyde met all primary efficacy endpoints and demonstrated a favorable safety profile across four Phase III studies including 2,500 patients. Rates of adverse reactions for Icotyde treated patients were within 1.1% of placebo through Week 16.

key_facts.fact: Psoriasis affects more than 8 million Americans; the new oral option addresses an unmet need for patients who fail topical treatments and are candidates for systemic therapy.
key_facts.excerpt: Psoriasis affects more than 8 million Americans, impacting physical comfort and quality of life, especially when lesions are on visible or sensitive areas.

sources.title: FDA approves Icotyde (icotrokinra) for first-line systemic treatment of plaque psoriasis with a targeted oral peptide - Johnson & Johnson
